data.summary: Results-driven Entrepreneur with over 10 years of experience in IT Project Management and AI-driven application development. Adept at leveraging Generative AI and Low-Code frameworks to accelerate project lifecycles and deploy rapid-response business solutions. Business Intelligence, and Digital Transformation, specializing in data-driven solutions and digital transformation within the financial services sector. Expert in end-to-end project lifecycle management, leveraging Agile/Scrum and Waterfall methodologies, alongside tools like Jira and DevOps for streamlined execution. My core competencies include comprehensive requirements gathering, user story development, test case formulation, and robust documentation (BRD, FSD, RTM). I possess strong analytical skills, with proficiency in data analysis, ETL, SQL, Power BI, and Cyara automation for impactful reporting. Adept at managing IT infrastructure projects, optimizing customer journeys in retail banking, and designing target operating models, I consistently drive process improvement, foster cross-functional collaboration, and manage vendor relationships to deliver strategic objectives and tangible value. Expert in leveraging SQL and Power BI to deliver data-driven strategic insights and executive-level analytics while managing complex financial workflows, including SWIFT operations and global ISO 20022 compliance.

responsibilities: Spearheaded the UI/UX development team through complex analytical dashboard constructions, ensuring 100% compliance with business requirement documents (BRD) and user story specifications.
Facilitated client-facing requirement discovery workshops to map intricate business process workflows into clear Functional Specification Documents (FSD) and System Requirement Specifications (SRS).

Provided exhaustive lifecycle support for infrastructure modernization initiatives, effectively managing planning stages, project tracking via Jira/Azure DevOps, budget constraints, and risk mitigation strategies.
Partnered with core QA teams to compile end-to-end test cases, evaluate functional UI testing parameters, track defect lifecycles, and run user acceptance testing (UAT).

Identified, mapped, and deployed fresh KPIs and performance metrics using advanced MS Excel formulas (Pivot tables, Lookups) and Power BI dashboards, translating raw source data into executive-level presentations.
Collaborated closely with the corporate finance division and Head Accountant to manage vendor quote reviews, negotiate commercial contracts, and perform strict cost/benefit and risk analyses.
Served as the strategic bridge across business, engineering, QA, and sales teams to orchestrate day-to-day project operations, streamline release management, and actively prioritize product backlogs.
Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, SDLC Governance, Sprint Planning, Product Backlog Prioritization, Change Management.
Established a full-scale IT and BPO services firm, overseeing legal incorporation, brand identity, and strategic market positioning.
Spearheaded the setup of a high-tech delivery centre, managing end-to-end IT infrastructure, seat allocation, and operational readiness.
Leading multi-national contract negotiations and optimizing resource allocation to ensure the seamless delivery of large-scale, high-stakes global projects.
Engineered a robust recruitment engine, successfully sourcing and vetting high-performing FTEs for international fintech and support projects.
Leveraging 10+ years of BI expertise to build proprietary reporting tools and dashboards to provide clients with real-time operational transparency.
Internation Project: Travel Desk (Voice, email & chat), chat support.
Integrated Google Generative AI with SQL Server backends to automate the creation of proprietary reporting tools and dashboards, enhancing real-time operational transparency for global clients.
Currently serving as a Project Manager, acting as a vital link between business, development, and testing teams, ensuring smooth coordination and communication.
Acquired comprehensive knowledge in the payment’s domain, including handling vendors and partners to develop cutting-edge products and ensuring successful product implementation and delivery.
Proficient in negotiating with vendors and managing internal expectations to optimize organizational satisfaction.
Successfully implemented and managed change initiatives, including implementation of a new CRM system and app development.
Responsible for coordinating day-to-day project operations with service providers.
Documenting requirements for extended ATM technology and fintech needs, including creating technical scope documents and obtaining quotes from vendors.
Led UI team in dashboard development, ensuring compliance with business requirements and BRD specifications.
Estimated analysis efforts and devised plans aligned with project timelines for efficient execution.
Created BRD, FSD & User Story and utilized Azure DevOps/JIRA for tracking requirements, changes, and issue resolutions.

Experience providing comprehensive support throughout the project lifecycle, including planning, execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, budgeting, and quality assurance in IT infrastructure projects.
Collaborated with testing team to develop comprehensive test cases, ensuring coverage of all scenarios.
In-depth experience in executing QA processes and ensuring deliverables meet quality standards.
Engaged with diverse stakeholders to gather and understand process requirements, delivering cohesive solutions.
Identified new KPIs and metrics to measure performance against business objectives using tools like Power BI.
Provided regular status reports to team and management, fostering transparency and accountability.
Gathered data from internal and external sources, generating insightful reports for decision-making.
Managed project administration tasks, ensuring smooth execution and adherence to timelines.
Actively participated in test case verification, ensuring alignment with project objectives.
Spearheaded delivery of cost-effective, high-performance technology solutions aligned with project objectives and budget constraints.
Spearheading the transformation and validation of financial messaging to align with global ISO 20022 compliance standards.
Managed high-volume cross-border financial transactions with a strong focus on security, processing accuracy, and liquidity management.
Deep domain knowledge in retail banking systems, ATM technology networks, payments, and robust CRM integrations.
Led complex financial messaging transformations, schema mapping, and validation workflows to meet global compliance standards.
Facilitated business requirements gathering sessions, ensuring alignment with project goals.
Analysed client requests and delivered presentation-quality dashboards and reports for enhanced insights.
Presented business process workflows to stakeholders, fostering understanding and alignment.
Coordinated project issues, risks, and change controls, ensuring timely resolution and mitigation.
Managed various financial calculations and reporting, providing comprehensive insights for decision-making.
In my academic pursuit encompassing both my BBA and MBA degrees, I was engaged in multiple internships across a diverse spectrum of industries including Banking, Insurance, and Mining companies.
Birla Sunlife Insurance – Structure of Indian Banking Sector and Financial Institution, Portfolio Management, Equity Research and Derivatives.
HDFC – A study on the role of financial company in agency channel of HDFC Life.
Canara Bank - Financial analysis, Documentation, Solution development and delivery and financial evaluation
BEML Ltd – A study on Working Capital Management with reference to BEML Ltd.
